message-an-agent-structure-and-flow-1--n.label: LAYOUT LAW. Y = distance from the outside world: band 1 outside, band 2 boundary, band 3 core, band 4 stores. X = lane. Every crossing of the boundary happens at a named gate and nowhere else. AMBER thick wires = Flow 1 execution, numbered by step. Neutral wires = static structure. RED-DOTTED wires = holes in the spec.

message-an-agent-structure-and-flow-1--b.label: Band 2 — Boundary. One gate per crossing.

message-an-agent-structure-and-flow-1--n.label: STRUCTURE — entity relationships and cardinality, read source to target.
FLOW 1 — you create an Agent and send its first message. Follow the amber numbers.
HOLES — named in the spec as unresolved. Do not silently omit them.

message-an-agent-structure-and-flow-1--w.label: one Agent works sessions over time
null on first send, backfilled after assignment
same acceptance path as a human
17 · acceptSend validates conversation, agent, text, clientOpId
18 · append SendJournal state accepted, targetSessionId null
21 · dispatch text with AgentId in child env
23 and 24 · OUT — prompt to the provider, response back
25 · provider writes sessionId, prompt, hook marker, response
26 · IN — the only pathway into Novakai, tail bytes only
28 and 29 · append ProviderSession, agentId still null
35 · ingested user line proves which turn accepted your message
38, 39 and 40 · RETURN — subscription delivers new lines, window rerenders
32 · update Agent.sessionId — FUNCTION MISSING FROM PLAN
37 · publish transcript event — FUNCTION NAME MISSING FROM PLAN
